ruleDefinitions.name: Add Windows Capability Via PowerShell Cmdlet
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Add-WindowsCapability" cmdlet to add Windows capabilities. Notable capabilities could be "OpenSSH" and others.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-WindowsCapability.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenSSH\\\..*"))
